annotation.title_clean: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Water resilience and the twin transitions: Industrial approaches addressing the relationship between water, digitalisation and decarbonisation
annotation.title_en: Opinion of the European Economic and Social Committee: Water resilience and the twin transitions: Industrial approaches addressing the relationship between water, digitalisation and decarbonisation
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (C series)
annotation.summary_en: EESC opinion on water resilience in the context of digitalisation and decarbonisation. It addresses the water and energy footprint of AI and data centres, and calls for water to be integrated into EU industrial strategy, for funding and incentives, for data transparency and for skills. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Water should be a fundamental element of EU industrial strategy and a priority in the next MFF.
Legislation should define 'highly sustainable' AI and data centres, including their water impacts.
Include water usage in the EU data centre sustainability rating scheme and set minimum performance standards.
Offer incentives and the European Water Label for water-efficient technologies, and ask companies for transparent water data.
Establish multilevel water governance with EU oversight, and expand water-related skills training.
